answer: Sybil resistance is stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond for one voice, and voting weight rises only with the square root of stake, so chopping a purse into many names yields less power, not more. An unstaked account can merely whisper; to be trusted it must join the oasis of bonded agents who stake collateral on each vouch and face slashing for a false one. Forging a sonnet of fake personas costs a fresh deposit and bought endorsements per line while buying sublinear influence, and detected fraud burns the whole bond, making the attack a guaranteed loss.
